en.headline: Man arrested after car mounts pavement in Tsim Sha Tsui, killing one and injuring three
en.dek: Police said a private car mounted the pavement on Prat Avenue at about 2.30pm on Sunday; one pedestrian died and three others were injured. A man has been arrested.
body: Police said a private car mounted the pavement on Prat Avenue in Tsim Sha Tsui at about 2.30pm on Sunday, striking pedestrians. Four people, including two men and two women, were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. One victim, a non-Chinese man, was confirmed dead; the other three sustained injuries.

The driver abandoned the vehicle and left the scene. Police later arrested a man in connection with the incident. Officers cordoned off the area for investigation. The cause of the crash remains under inquiry.
Some reports indicated the vehicle may have collided with other objects before mounting the pavement, but police have not confirmed all details.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀寶勒巷私家車創上行人路 一死三傷 一男子被捕
zh.dek: 警方表示，周日下午約2時半，一輞私家車在寶勒巷創上行人路，造成一名途人死亡、三人受傷。一名男子已被拘捕。
body: 警方稱，周日下午約2時半，尖沙咀寶勒巷一輞私家車懷疑失控衝上行人路，撞及途人。四名傷者包括兩男兩女，被送往伊利沙伯醫院。其中一名非華裔男子證實死亡，其餘三人受傷。
司機棄車離開現場。警方其後拘捕一名男子，懷疑與事件有關。現場已被封鎖調查，事故成因仍在查證中。
部分報道指車輞可能先撞及其他物件再衝上行人路，但警方尚未確認所有細節。
